End-to-end LLM-driven algorithm discovery for auto-bidding

ADAGEAutomated discovery of auto-bidding algorithms

ADAGE is an end-to-end application of LLM-driven algorithm discovery to auto-bidding. We evaluate its discovered policies in simulation and in a real-world advertising platform.

We further apply ADAGE to a real-world bidding task and validate the discovered policy through an 11-day online A/B test, achieving +3.25% ROI and +6.67% GMV. The policy is now deployed to 100% of traffic on a leading e-commerce advertising platform.

How well does ADAGE work?

Task performance

ADAGE achieves improvements on both benchmark tasks. Its discovered bidding policy also increases GMV and ROI in an online A/B test and has been subsequently deployed to production.

Simulation resultsBest discovered candidates across three independent runs
+3.1%Bidding-policy optimization · higher is betterTotal GMV vs. the task-specific AIGB-Pearl baseline
−28.3%Bidding-environment modeling · lower is betterMacro-averaged MAE vs. the task-specific Bid2X baseline
Online A/B testAugust 4–14, 2026 · 20% treatment vs. 20% control traffic
+6.67%GMV vs. the control policy
+3.25%ROI vs. the control policy

Approximately one million transactions per group · deployed to 100% production traffic after validation.
